common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.title: Shops near you
home.emptyBody: We are setting things up. Please check back soon.
home.noneNearBody: Try another place, or look at all shops.
home.noLocation: We could not get your location.
home.outsideSriLanka: That place is outside Sri Lanka.

shop.title: Shop
shop.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the shop is closed for now.
shop.noProductsBody: This shop has no products in this category.

order.title: Order
order.notFoundBody: It may belong to another account.
order.codeBody: Tell the driver this code when you get your order.
order.revisionBody: Compare, then accept to go on to payment.
order.cancelBody: The delivery window is given back. You can order again any time.
order.paying: Taking you to the payment page…
order.payFailed: We could not start the payment.
order.bankBody: Transfer {amount} and use the reference below. The shop confirms when the money arrives.
order.reportDone: Thanks, we have it. The shop or our team will get back to you.
order.listEmptyBody: When you order, it will show up here.

console.soon: The order panel is coming soon.
console.title: Console
console.body: Pick where you want to work.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page has moved.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.body: Use your Google account to see your orders and check out. We never post anything.
auth.inviteBody: Sign in with the Google account your invite was sent to.
auth.privacy: We keep your name, e-mail and the details you add here.
auth.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not set up in this build.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in could not load. Check your connection.

guard.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.
guard.signInBody: This page is for signed-in people.
guard.deniedTitle: This page isn't for your account
guard.deniedBody: If you think it should be, ask the shop owner or the platform admin.

totp.setupBody: Admin screens ask for a 6-digit code each time you sign in. Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the first code it shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.codeBody: Open your authenticator app and type the current 6-digit code.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: Like 0771234567. We send one text with a code.
phone.invalid: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, like 0771234567.

onboarding.nameHint: Shops see this on your orders.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.signOutAllBody: You will be signed out on every phone and computer.
account.deleteBody: You will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again. We remove your phone number and saved addresses. Your past orders stay in the shop's and our records.
account.deleteBlocked: You can't delete your account yet:

blocked.orders: You have an order in progress or a bill that is not paid yet.
blocked.refunds: A refund is still being paid out to you.
blocked.team: You work in a shop team. Ask the owner or the admin to remove you first.
blocked.cart: Your cart still has items. Empty it first.

address.label: Name this place
address.makeDefault: Use this as my main address
address.pinMissing: Put a pin on the map.
address.outside: That pin is outside Sri Lanka.
address.tooMany: You can keep up to 5 addresses. Remove one to add another.
address.noShops: No shop delivers here yet. You can still look around.
address.emptyBody: Add one so shops can tell if they deliver to you.
address.removeBody: “{label}” will be removed from your account.

map.label: Map. Tap to place the pin.
map.noLocation: We couldn't get your location. Enter the pin below instead.

search.startBody: Type at least {min} letters, like rice or milk.
search.noneBody: Check the spelling, or try a shorter word.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyBody: Add something from a shop and it will show up here.
cart.switchBody: Your cart has items from {from}. Clear it and start a new cart with {to}?

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.otherHint: A friend's house, your office, anywhere. Just for this order.
checkout.otherLabelHint: Like Mum's house. We use "Other place" if you leave it empty.
checkout.otherNote: We do not save this place to your addresses.
checkout.noSlots: No delivery windows are open right now.
checkout.excluded: These items are not available now and are not in the bill. Remove them from your cart to go on.
checkout.priceChanged: The price changed since you added it.
checkout.ifMissing: If it is out of stock:
checkout.problemClosed: The shop is closed right now.
checkout.problemRange: This place is too far for this shop. Pick another place.
checkout.problemMin: Your items are below the shop's minimum order.
checkout.problemExcluded: Remove the unavailable items from your cart.
checkout.phoneBody: The shop and the driver call this number about your order.
checkout.noteHint: Like gate code or when to call.
checkout.afterSend: The shop checks your bill first. You pay once it is approved.
